body.name: Centered Fourier covariance region
body.construction: If \(t_N\ge1\) and \(m_N\ge2\varepsilon_N\), set \(z_u=-2t_N^{-2}\{\log(\max(|\widehat\phi_N(t_Nu)|,m_N/2))+q_u\log(1+t_N)-(\log c+\log C)/2\}\), \(w_N=t_N^{-2}\{\log(C/c)+4\varepsilon_N/m_N\}\), polarize by \((Z_N)_{ii}=z_{e_i}\) and \((Z_N)_{ij}=(z_{e_i+e_j}-z_{e_i}-z_{e_j})/2\), set \(\Delta_N=3pw_N/2\), set \(\widehat\Gamma_N=\operatorname{clip}_{[\lambda,\Lambda]}(Z_N)\), and set \(K_N=\{H:\lambda I\preceq H\preceq\Lambda I,\ \|H-\widehat\Gamma_N\|_{\mathrm{op}}\le2\Delta_N\}\). Otherwise set \(\widehat\Gamma_N=((\lambda+\Lambda)/2)I\) and \(K_N=\{H:\lambda I\preceq H\preceq\Lambda I\}\).
